title: Construction of a new road project begins in Bomet County
summary: Construction work has begun on a new road project in Bomet County. The county government says the project is intended to improve transport links, support local businesses and make movement easier for residents. Further project details should be confirmed from the official project documentation or county government statement before publication.

confirmed: The project is in Bomet County.
The county government says the project is intended to improve transport links.
